visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian female with dark hair tied back in a professional pony style, wearing a white short-sleeved blouse with puffed sleeves under a black sleeveless vest, sits centered in a brightly lit studio. To her left is a large, round orange plush mascot with large white eyes and black glasses, maintaining a static cheerful expression. She speaks directly to the camera with an animated face, using her hands to count and gesture as she talks. (2) As she discusses travel apps, a green icon for 'NAVITIME' appears near her shoulder. Her hand gestures are precise, pointing to her palm to emphasize individual points. The setting is a clean, minimalist white studio with even lighting across her face and the mascot. A white table in front of her holds several sheets of printed paper. (3) When the topic shifts to taxis, the icon for 'GO' appears on screen. The speaker’s expressions are helpful and encouraging, with focused eye contact and slight smiles. Text overlays in the upper third of the frame provide contextual headlines in orange and white. (4) Transitioning to food services, the red and yellow McDonald's logo appears. She uses wider, expansive hand gestures to describe app benefits. The background remains a simple white wall, ensuring the character and the graphical icons remain the focal points. (5) Discussing beauty services, the pink 'HOT PEPPER Beauty' logo is displayed. She leans slightly forward, her body language appearing inviting. The editing uses straight cuts to keep the pace aligned with her speech. (6) In the final segment, large red variety-style text overlays appear promoting her YouTube channel. A pink end-screen graphic then replaces the studio shot, displaying multiple social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube alongside a QR code and website URL.

It aims to reduce travel stress by offering curated, expert advice through a highly accessible short-form format.
